---
title: "Trends"
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
attacks <- read_rds("data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
activities_with_50 <- attacks |>
  count(Activity, name = "attacks") |>
  filter(attacks >= 50)

fatal_by_activity <- attacks |>
  semi_join(activities_with_50, by = "Activity") |>
  filter(Fatal_clean != "Unknown") |>
  count(Activity, Fatal_clean, name = "attacks")

ggplot(fatal_by_activity, aes(x = reorder(Activity, attacks, sum), y = attacks, fill = Fatal_clean)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Fatal vs non-fatal shark attacks by activity",
    x = "Activity",
    y = "Number of attacks",
    fill = "Outcome"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
